description: This Java class handles configuration related to Kafka bootstrap servers, including validation, merging configuration sources, and applying settings to producer properties in the context of a service connectivity framework.

classes.name: KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing Kafka bootstrap server configuration, validation, and merging logic in a connection context.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if this configuration is applicable to a given connection. Always returns true for bootstrap server config.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection's bootstrap server configuration and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the bootstrap server configuration in the connection is valid according to the pattern.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Merges bootstrap server configurations from URI and specific config, validates, and applies it to producer properties.
